head: Year
Event
rows: First Watch masons sink seven meteoric Anchor Seals into the caldera floor to bleed primordial magma pressure away from the upper provinces.
The Crown of Order is forged from fallen star-iron and quenched in alpine snow, binding the First Sovereign to Thornvael's tectonic stability.
Dwarven smith-clans and northern border lords sign the First Compact in iron and tallow, establishing the Undervault drainage galleries.
Twelve primeval quartz wardstones are raised across the Redmarsh plateau to anchor coastal rain-clouds and pin alkali dust below the passes.
Third-Dynasty inland-sea magistrates codify Probate Debt Law, ruling that unpaid granary and tax liens remain enforceable after death.
Imperial masons complete Alder Bridge using Craghorn granite and slaked lime, opening the sole heavy artillery artery to the northern moors.
Geo-sorcerers of the Age of Chains bind living bedrock into Elder Juggernauts to guard mountain passes without wages or rations.
The inland sea evaporates following a southern fault-shift, leaving behind the Redmarsh salt-pans and stranding Third-Dynasty port vaults.
Oakhaven's merchant guild secures the Whale-Oil Charter, financing Harborwatch's great lighthouse and boom-chain fortifications.
Three northern kings refuse to pay the caldera maintenance tithe and are beheaded at the Threshold crossroads, where their headless statues still stand.
Expelled scholars from the Capital Collegium publish the first treatise on Arcane Thermodynamics, proving invocations act as pressure valves.
Exiled dwarven engineers seal the lower Undervault inspection shafts with lead after northern bailiffs use the tunnels to hide clipped silver.
The Lantern-Keeper hermit order strings iron-caged oil beacons through Lantern Passage to guide caravans around the deepest fen sinks.
Deep Quarry prison gangs cut three hundred feet into black ironstone seams before striking an underground spring that floods the lowest gallery.
Arch-Mage Malrik trades his sight to read subterranean magma veins, sparking the Caldera Schism as half the Crown College follows him south.
Brother Elias and surviving Collegium archivists don iron collars, founding the Scorched Penitents to guard against unbinding the Anchor Seals.
High Quartermaster Morvessa drafts the emergency Salt Tithe, stripping border parishes of brine, grain, and iron ore to fund southern forts.
Thornwick's Border Mint is burned to the ground after Assayer Pell uncovers shaved silver groats stamped with worn commission dies.
Ashen Coven sorcerers under Mordred and Hexer Saelen establish secret blood-altars in the Sunken Sanctum and Redmarsh willow hollows.
Gorrathul's engineers conceal the silting of Ironheart Bastion's lower water cisterns while conscripting miners to fortify the mountain pass.
Lord Admiral Vesperion assembles the Black Fleet of copper-sheeted war galleys to blockade Oakhaven and sever coastal supply routes.

Pikemen hold Alder Bridge through three raider assaults while three thousand river-parish refugees evacuate south toward Redmarsh.
Commander Velen's siege-rams shatter Ashbrook Gatehouse; defenders burn the manor granary and retreat across the southern border ditch.

title: The Border Fords Wardens
summary: Remnants of Thornwick's provincial levy and bridge-pickets who held the Alder River crossings after the Salt Tithe stripped their armories. Stubborn, mud-stained pragmatists who value dry powder, honest weight, and unbroken watch-rotations above noble titles.

p: Remnants of Thornwick's provincial levy and bridge-pickets who held the Alder River crossings after the Salt Tithe stripped their armories. Stubborn, mud-stained pragmatists who value dry powder, honest weight, and unbroken watch-rotations above noble titles.

list: Hostile: Keep your hand off your hilt—every sentry on the Alder has orders to drop you on sight.
Wary: We know your face from the toll-rolls, stranger. State your business and keep moving.
Neutral: The mud doesn't care who wears the crown, and neither do we. Pay your toll and pass.
Friendly: Good to see dry steel at the gate. Quartermaster left extra bolts by the brazier for you.
Honored: When the river rose red, you stood on the planks with us. Every ford in the north is yours.

title: Redmarsh Salt-Caravaneers
summary: Guild of alkali-haulers, cistern-guards, and dune-scouts keeping trade moving across the evaporated inland sea. Bound by strict water-sharing oaths, they despise both Morvessa's tax-bailiffs and Sand-Clan ambushers who bleed their supply trains.

list: Hostile: Not a drop of water or a pinch of salt for thieves—ride back into the alkali dust.
Wary: Keep clear of the lead wagons until the outriders check your saddlebags for tax-badges.
Neutral: Silver buys hardbread and boiled brine; trouble buys an arrow from the canyon rim.
Friendly: You cleared the corduroy road when our axles sank. Draw from the clean cask at half price.
Honored: Your name is carved on every milestone well from Redmarsh to the pass. Ride at our head.

list: Hostile: Your name is entered in red gall-ink; even death will not discharge what you owe this parish.
Wary: Touch nothing on the probate shelves unless you carry a witnessed writ of inheritance.
Neutral: Every soul owes a final ledger-balance. Keep your accounts current and we have no quarrel.
Friendly: Your field audits saved three crypt vaults from grave-robbers. The archives are open to you.
Honored: By seal and tallow, your debts are forgiven in perpetuity, and our witnesses answer your call.

title: Oakhaven Maritime Guild
summary: Shipwrights, lighthouse keepers, and culverin-masters governing the walled hill-city where the Greywash meets the sea. Shrewd tariff-collectors who hoarded whale-oil behind bolted gates until Vesperion's blockade forced them to arm mercenaries.

list: Hostile: The harbor chains stay raised against pirates and traitors—turn back before the culverins fire.
Wary: Guild curfew bells ring at dusk. Keep to the lower piers and stay away from the drydocks.
Neutral: Pay the anchorage tariff in weighed coin and Oakhaven's chandlers will fit your company.
Friendly: You broke the fire-hulks off the outer mole. Our shipwrights will temper your steel free of charge.
Honored: The lighthouse burns in your honor tonight; every keel in Oakhaven sails at your command.

title: The Thermodynamic Conclave
summary: Dissident scholars and mint-assayers expelled from the Capital Collegium for proving that invocation magic obeys strict pressure and grounding laws. Armed with copper wire and quartz lenses, they repair ruptured wardstones while mocking priestly liturgy.

list: Hostile: Sloppy grounding and worse manners—get out of our laboratory before you short the wardstones.
Wary: Mind where you set your iron boots; that chalk circle is calibrated to three decimal grains.
Neutral: Bring intact quartz prisms or copper filings and we will trade you properly grounded runes.
Friendly: Your field readings from the plateau proved our pressure thesis. Take a calibrated focus.
Honored: You understand that magic is pure law, not superstition. The Conclave's vaults belong to you.

title: The Ironcamp Slag-Guild

list: Hostile: Step near the quenching troughs and we will hammer you flat like bad bog-iron.
Wary: Put on smoked goggles and keep your hands off the meteoric billets until Vok speaks for you.

Friendly: Good temper in your blade and no fear of sparks—the guild will re-forge your plate at cost.
Honored: You stood in the fissure heat when the walls shook. Our finest caldera steel bears your mark.

Wary: Speak softly in the cloister; our ears read the tremor of every lie in your boots.
Neutral: We tend the burned and copy the warnings left by the dead. Share water and rest in peace.
Friendly: You showed mercy where others brought torches. Let Brother Elias read the ash-scrolls for you.
Honored: Through soot and trial you have proven worthy of the threshold truth. Walk in our vigil.

title: The First Watch Remnant
summary: Undying spectral wardens and ancestral oath-keepers bound to the seven meteoric Anchor Seals beneath the Obsidian Dais. Stoic, ancient, and terrifyingly literal, they recognize only those who uphold the original compact to keep Thornvael from burning.
