p: Before the gnolls fired the river crossing, Collector Vance locked three months of border tariffs inside a weighted iron strongbox and kicked it into the reeds. Sergeant Garrick needs that silver to pay the militia's back-wages before they desert. Clear the Briar Hound packs scavenging the shallows and drag the box out of the mud.

Choice A: Hand the sealed strongbox to Garrick (+1 militia morale, unlocks cheaper mercs in Thornwick). Choice B: Pry the lock open with Old Fenwick and split the silver (+300 extra gold now, but Garrick's militia starts 'Alder Bridge' with 20% less HP).

Widow Marta's supply of marsh-antidote has run dry, and a dozen scouts from Bren's column are swelling up from poisoned iron arrowheads. She needs fresh gas-bladders harvested from Mire Wisps before their internal fire goes cold. Wade into the willow sinks and bring back intact specimens.

Choice A: Give all 6 bladders to Marta to save the scouts (Marta reduces potion prices by 20% permanently). Choice B: Sell the volatile bladders to the garrison sappers for fire-pots (+250 gold and +1 Fireball scroll, but 3 scouts die and Bren refuses to speak to you).

Four border watchmen abandoned the outer watchtower during the Ravenwatch siege, leaving their comrades to be butchered by Quill Fiends. They are currently hiding in a hunter's blind near the pine line, guarded by feral packs. Hunt down the Quill Fiends around the blind and deal with the deserters according to martial law.

Choice A: Execute the deserters on the spot as Garrick ordered (grants +2 Body elixir, reveals Garrick's nephew secret). Choice B: Conscript them into your vanguard for the Sunken Sanctum (you gain 2 free disposable spearman mercs for the next mission, but Garrick withholds the gold reward).

A flat-bottomed sulfur barge grounded on the gravel shoals north of the ford three nights ago. Cinder Shamans have already set up fire-chanting braziers on the deck, drying the casks to cook river-salt into blasting powder. Clear the ritualists off the hull before the whole bend goes up in orange smoke.

Choice A (Return the salvaged sulfur casks to npc-fenwick-ferryman): Fenwick smuggles them upriver; in Act 3, npc-kors-shipwright in town-oakhaven charges -20% on hull and shield repairs. Choice B (Dump the casks into the river to deny everyone powder): m08-alder-bridge has 3 fewer cinderling spawns, but npc-fenwick-ferryman raises river-crossing fees by +25% and mutters about 'pious drowners of good freight'.

Hobb forged forty iron axle-pins and twelve billhooks on militia credit, and the clerk who carried the tallow-skin ledger bolted into the Greywood when the vanguard split. Without those tallies, the garrison captain refuses to pay a single copper. Pull the oilskin ledger out of the wrecked supply cart before the root-beasts pulp it.

Choice A (Give the unaltered ledger to npc-hobb-smith): Hobb gets his payout and unlocks tier-2 weapon tempering at -15% cost in town-thornwick, while npc-garrick-captain loses face and gives no bonus rations before m09-ironhide-hunt. Choice B (Sell the ledger to npc-garrick-captain to cover up his requisition embezzlement): You gain +90 extra gold immediately, but in Act 2 npc-bram-quartermaster in town-redmarsh recognizes the forged tallies and increases his shop prices by +15%.

Marta's apprentice went out to tap birch-tar near the oldwatch cairns and came back with three translucent crystal shards wedged in his collarbone. A flock of Glasswings has nested in the dead ash trees above the road, blinding scouts with refracted glare. Bring down the brood-leaders so their wing-slivers can be ground into sight-salve.

Choice A (Let npc-marta-alchemist distill the wings into militia eye-drops): Ranged mercenaries gain +5 accuracy during m11-ashbrook-retreat, and Marta greets you as 'the one who kept our eyes open'. Choice B (Grind the crystal dust into trade-poison for yourself): Marta's apprentice loses sight in one eye and she refuses to brew cold-resistance draughts for the rest of Act 1, though your party gains +120 gold from contraband buyers.

Three mule-trains of salted mutton and cold-iron arrowheads vanished between the Twin Passes and the marsh palisade. Bram suspects the drivers staged an ambush and sold the crates to desert nomads, though the canyon floor is crawling with Pale Burrowers. Escort Bram's bonded tally-clerk to the overturned wagons in the gorge so he can count the branding-irons on the dead mules.

Choice A (Report the drivers' desertion honestly to npc-bram-quartermaster): Bram hangs the surviving driver's brother; his shop stock expands with heavy bolts at -10% price, but in m20-deep-quarry 2 extra sand-raider mercs join the enemy side for revenge. Choice B (Falsify the audit and blame the burrowers): The driver's kin slips you 180 gold in hush-money, but npc-bram-quartermaster runs short on iron and removes all shield items from his store.

When the wardstone ruptured, the peat bog drained enough to expose three pre-dynastic boundary steles carved with marsh-binding glyphs. Zahra needs charcoal-and-tallow rubbings of the inscriptions before the rising mire-water and Spore Matrons dissolve the limestone. Reach the three sunken steles in the outer fen and hold the ground long enough to press the parchment.

Choice A (Give all three rubbings to npc-zahra-scholar): She deciphers the marsh hexes, reducing enemy witch-doctor curse duration in m19-hexer-capture, and in Act 4 npc-elias-penitent in town-ironcamp recognizes her annotations and shares his secret dialogue early. Choice B (Burn the third stele's rubbing as demanded by a cornered witch-doctor in exchange for his fetish-cache): You receive +250 gold, but m19-hexer-capture spawns 1 additional spore-matron and Zahra calls you an illiterate grave-robber.

Tull's stone cistern at the edge of the landing has turned thick and green, smelling of copper and boiled maggots. A pair of Lantern Eels burrowed up through the broken limestone filter-grate and are laying shock-eggs in the town's only sweet-water reserve. Kill the eels in the cistern vaults before Tull is forced to sell boiled bog-water at famine prices.

Choice A (Clean the cistern grate and flush the eggs): npc-tull-water-seller lowers potion and flask prices in town-redmarsh by -20%, and in Act 3 npc-sera-healer in town-oakhaven receives clean water barrels, granting your party +15 max HP during m27-field-infirmary. Choice B (Harvest the intact shock-eggs for alchemical sale): Tull's water remains brackish, his prices rise by +20%, and 2 extra maggot-swarm packs appear in m21-lean-garrison, though you pocket +300 gold from lightning-salts.

After the granary raid, half the barley silos are infested with Ruin Mites chewing through the foundation mortar. Bram's laborers set up peat-smoke braziers to suffocate the swarm in the lower vaults, but the smell of roasting chitin draws bog predators out of the reeds. Defend the four smoking braziers at the silo doors until the vaults are purged.

Choice A (Vent the silos early to save the trapped convict laborers coughing inside): Two laborers survive and join the garrison, removing 2 dune-lurker ambushes in m21-lean-garrison, but 30% of the grain spoils and Bram deducts 80 gold from your pay. Choice B (Keep the heavy iron doors barred until every mite is dead): You get the full 310 gold plus a 90 gold bonus, but npc-bram-quartermaster's dialogue turns grim as the town eats smoked grain that smells of dead prisoners.

Deep quarry blasting broke into an older salt-brick burial gallery where Crypt Embalmers still tend rows of bitumen-sealed jars. Zahra wants four jars of unspoiled funerary pitch to seal her parchment crates against the marsh rot. Slay the embalmers guarding the lower gallery before they wake the rest of the alcoves.

Choice A (Deliver the sealed jars to npc-zahra-scholar): She preserves her treatise and teaches your mage/healer +10 poison_res permanently. Choice B (Crack the jars to loot the gold tongue-plates inside the viscera): You gain +220 gold, but breaking the seals releases necrotic fumes that cause 2 additional greater-mummy enemies to spawn in Act 3's m28-sunken-citadel.

The fleeing column from the south ridges abandoned their brass water-wagons in the dry scrub when the Dune Beasts struck. Tull knows those brass tanks are worth more than the mules that pulled them, and he wants the copper valves stripped before Sand Raiders haul them off. Collect six stamped brass valves from the wrecked wagons along the ridge trail.

Choice A (Leave two full water-tanks intact for the stragglers hiding in the rocks): You return with fewer valves (-100 gold), but the surviving scouts mark enemy paths for you, removing 3 claw-viper ambushes in m23-fork-of-spears. Choice B (Drain every tank to strip all six valves quickly): Tull pays the full reward and offers a discount on mana flasks, but the stragglers die of thirst and rise as 3 hollow-knight enemies in m23-fork-of-spears.

Sera's heavy ambulance wagon is bogged down in axle-deep shingle half a mile outside the field infirmary, surrounded by Cinderlings drawn to fever-heat of the wounded. Inside are twelve amputees from the sundered ranks and all of Oakhaven's willow-bark laudanum. Defend the wagon until the ox-team can be hitched and dragged behind the palisade.

Choice A (Save the wounded soldiers at the cost of jettisoning the laudanum crate): The soldiers survive; in Act 4, npc-rowan-commander in town-ironcamp has 2 extra veteran guards and reduces mercenary hiring costs by -20%, though npc-sera-healer's healing services in Act 3 cost +25% more. Choice B (Abandon the back litter of dying men to save the heavy medicine chest): Sera's shop prices drop by -20% in town-oakhaven, but her greeting turns cold ('We saved the bottles, didn't we?') and 2 hollow-knight enemies appear in m30-starved-bastion.

Kors cannot brace the harbor boom-chains without heartwood beams of mountain ironbark, and the timber sledges from the high pass are three days overdue. Frosthorn Bruisers have rolled boulders across the switchbacks and are using the logging sledges for firewood. Escort the surviving timber-wright and his two ox-sledges down the pass to the shipyard gates.

Choice A (Deliver all the ironbark timber to npc-kors-shipwright for the harbor boom): The harbor chains hold in m35-burning-harbor, reducing enemy redglass-drake spawns by 1, and Kors upgrades your shields. Choice B (Divert half the timber to npc-lyra-warden to shore up the town's bell-tower barricades): Lyra pays +200 gold and gives you extra traps in m30-starved-bastion, but Kors refuses to speak to you and m35-burning-harbor has 2 extra ash-weaver enemies boarding from the sea.

Three floating Frost Bells have drifted down from the highland rifts and anchored themselves in the sea-fog around the old watchtower at the riverlock. Every time the tide turns, their sub-audible tolling cracks the mortar of the floodgates and freezes the sentries' fingers to their crossbows. Shatter all three astral bells before the lock-gates burst.

Choice A (Melt the bronze shards down for npc-lyra-warden's watchmen): Lyra outfits her pickets with cold-forged bolts; in m34-clashing-banners, allied archers assist you at the flank. Choice B (Leave one cracked bell hanging at the riverlock as a resonant ward against flyers): It keeps rift-moth enemies out of m31-riverlock-crossing, but the constant freezing chime drives two of Lyra's sentries mad, increasing town guard bribe/toll costs by +15%.

When the neap tide pulls back from the sunken citadel causeway, the mudflats glint with pay-chests dropped during the first evacuation. Pip knows where the paymaster's iron strongboxes sank, but a colony of armored Salt Crabs has crusted over the wrecks like living reefs. Collect five barnacle-welded strongboxes from the flats before the tide and the crabs close in.

Choice A (Split the salvaged military payroll 50/50 with npc-pip-mudlark as promised): Pip opens his black-market curio stash in town-oakhaven at -25% discount and tips you off about a hidden chest in m32-elder-juggernaut. Choice B (Confiscate the strongboxes in the name of the garrison and hand them to npc-lyra-warden): You receive a 300 gold commendation from Lyra, but Pip vanishes from town-oakhaven permanently, locking out his fence shop.

Above the starved bastion lies a terraced apple grove that drank too much ash and unburied blood; now its trunks walk as Night Orchards, hanging human skulls from their boughs like winter fruit. The soldiers on the ramparts hear the skulls chattering their dead brothers' names through the fog. Cut down the two eldest orchard-trees so the garrison can sleep.

Choice A (Burn the skull-fruit in quicklime as npc-sera-healer asks): Garrison morale steadies, giving your party +10 mind in m33-high-stakes-gambit. Choice B (Harvest the glowing skull-lanterns for Act 4 siege illumination): In Act 4, npc-vok-forgemaster in town-ironcamp buys them for +450 gold to light his slag-tunnels, but npc-sera-healer refuses to speak anything but a single disgusted line for the rest of Act 3.

To stop the dread-fleet from landing at the harbor mole, Kors is packing three leaky coastal cogs with oil-soaked cordage and sulfur to ram the vanguard. Ash Weavers have already infiltrated the drydocks, spinning flame-threads across the rigging to detonate the hulls prematurely. Reach the three fire-ships moored along the outer jetty and cut the burning webs.

Choice A (Launch the fire-ships early into the narrow channel): They sink the enemy vanguard barge, removing 2 doom-knight enemies from m35-burning-harbor, but the burning oil slick destroys Kors's lower boathouse, raising his repair costs by +20%. Choice B (Hold the fire-ships until the merchant barges clear the mole): The merchants reward you with +350 gold in Act 4 at town-ironcamp, but 1 extra cinderhorn lands on the docks in m35-burning-harbor.

The outer curtain wall is buckling under the siege-breakers, and a vanguard of Dread Knights has planted black iron banners on the east parapet to guide the hell-mortars. Rowan needs someone to walk the broken battlements and hurl those knights into the ditch before the mortar-crews zero in on the command tent. Slay five Dread Knights holding the eastern wall-walk.

Choice A (Use the captured black iron banners to reinforce the breach-gates): m42-outer-rampart starts with reinforced gates (+30% barricade durability), and npc-rowan-commander grants access to his elite reserve armory. Choice B (stake the Dread Knights' armor along the glacis as a grim warning): It provokes the hell-vanguard; m41-gauntlet-of-iron spawns 2 extra doom-knight champions, but each drops guaranteed high-tier rune-iron (+400 gold value).

Vok's great steam-trip hammer cracked its bedplate, and no terrestrial iron can take the heat of the ember-steel he needs to forge for the final push. Only the living anvil-jaw of an Anvilmaw Smith from the cinder-trenches stays hard at white heat. Hunt down two of the forge-titans beyond the shattered beacons and drag their lower jaws back on chains.

Choice A (Bolt the demon jaws directly into Vok's town forge): npc-vok-forgemaster reduces all weapon and armor crafting/upgrade prices by -25% in town-ironcamp, though the cursed soot gives your hero -5 cold_res. Choice B (Quench the jaws in holy salt before mounting them, as npc-elias-penitent begs): The metal loses half its heat-temper (no shop discount from Vok, who calls you a superstitious fool), but npc-elias-penitent blesses your party with +15 fire_res for the rest of Act 4.

Before Elias took the penitent's chains, he was tutor to the young nobles of the Ember Court—and it was his syllabus of pyromantic theorems that taught the court to open the cinder-gates. Four lead-bound cylinders containing his original lecture notes are still locked in the ruined scriptorium along the gauntlet. Collect the four cylinders so he can burn his life's work in clean fire.

Choice A (Let npc-elias-penitent melt the cylinders in the brazier): Elias finds peace, his dialogue changes to quiet resolve, and he permanently grants your party +8 mind and +10 mana_regen. Choice B (Keep the pyromantic theorems and sell them to npc-vok-forgemaster to superheat his blast furnaces): Vok pays +600 gold and adds fire-damage affixes to his shop stock, but Elias hangs himself in his cell before m44-threshold-choice, removing his NPC services from town-ironcamp.

Two ancient Stormtrees have rooted themselves in the mud of the three-roads siege works, acting as living lightning-rods that fry Rowan's catapult crews whenever the ash-clouds rub together. The engineers have rigged copper earthing-spikes, but someone has to defend the sappers while they drive the chains into the roots. Defend the sapper team at the outer rampart.

Choice A (Ground the lightning harmlessly into the bedrock): The catapults survive, bombarding m43-three-roads-siege and removing 2 basalt-brute enemies from the map. Choice B (Channel the Stormtrees' charge into the camp's iron Palisade): Any melee enemy striking the gates in m43-three-roads-siege takes lightning damage, but the surge kills three sappers and npc-rowan-commander deducts 300 gold in blood-compensation.

The forward battery at the three roads has burned through its last barrel of quenched ballista-bolts, and Cinderhorns are prowling the ash-dunes between the camp and the battery. Vok has loaded an iron-plated powder dray drawn by blind quarry-oxen, and no regular teamster will touch the reins. Escort the iron dray across the siege lines to the battery.

Choice A (Deliver the bolts to the forward battery as ordered): The ballistae pin down aerial threats, removing 2 redglass-drake enemies in m45-crown-of-order. Choice B (Detonate the powder dray inside the Cinderhorn breeding pit along the route): It wipes out all cinderhorn spawns in m44-threshold-choice, but npc-vok-forgemaster is furious over his lost iron dray and increases his repair fees by +30%.

In the sunken basilica beneath the threshold, the prelate-abomination Vesperion conducts a choir of hollow pipes carved from the collarbones of the first penitents. Every hymn it exhales drains the warmth from the living and turns camp sentries into sleepwalking husks. Enter the basilica before the final reckoning and silence Vesperion, the Hollow Choir.

Choice A (Shatter Vesperion's bone pipe-organ completely): The trapped souls disperse; in m46-ember-reckoning, boss ashkarath loses his spectral choir shield phase, making the final fight direct. Choice B (Bind the organ's main bone-pipe into your own standard as a war-horn): Your party gains +15% lifesteal and terrorizes lesser enemies in m46-ember-reckoning, but npc-rowan-commander and npc-elias-penitent refuse to stand near you in town-ironcamp, calling you the new Prelate of Ash.

Old Fenwick's wicker eel-traps below the Sunken Ford have been torn apart by Bog Leeches bloated on gnoll carrion. Worse, one trap snagged a waterproofed courier-tube stamped with the Border Mint's wax. Clear the leeches out of the weir stakes and pull up the cylinder before the river-rot eats the parchment.

Choice A (flag_fenwick_mint_returned: Deliver the sealed courier-tube to npc-garrick-captain): Garrick rewards you with +80 gold and unlocks +1 militia archer in m08-alder-bridge. Choice B (flag_fenwick_mint_fence: Let npc-fenwick-ferryman sell the wax dies to river smugglers): You pocket +160 gold immediately, but Fenwick's river-salvage prices rise by +15%.

Thornwick's smithy is down to damp birch charcoal that spits sparks and leaves iron brittle as glass. Two abandoned anthracite barrows sit just outside the Ravenwatch ditch, currently overrun by Bone Gnawers chewing the leather harness-straps. Haul four sacks of dry sea-coal back to Hobb's forge.

Half the pickets returning from the Sunken Sanctum are scratching their wrists raw with grey water-blisters. Widow Marta needs bitter marsh-rue growing along the flooded causeway steps, guarded by Drowned Thralls that rise whenever ripples touch the stone. Gather five bundles of marsh-rue before the rash reaches the archers' bow-hands.

A two-wheeled ammunition wain carrying three hundred ash-shaft quarrels threw its iron rim half a mile east of the Greywood fork. Garrick has two sappers jacking up the axle under cover of brambles while Briar Hounds circle the scent of tallow. Defend the wain until the wheel is wedged and rolled clear.

Choice A (flag_alder_bolts_garrison: Deliver all three hundred quarrels to npc-garrick-captain): Garrison crossbowmen gain +15% volley damage during m08-alder-bridge and m11-ashbrook-retreat. Choice B (flag_alder_bolts_sold: Sell half the crate to private caravan guards before reporting in): You gain +140 gold immediately, but Garrick docks your next ration issue (-10% starting stamina in m08-alder-bridge).

Alkali fog rolls across the Redmarsh flats every dusk, blinding supply columns straying off the stone causeway. Warden Hale's signal-braziers along the northern salt-pans have been toppled by Alkali Stalkers nesting in the dry reeds. Reach the three fallen tripod beacons and relight their oil-pans.

Desert raiders have strung hollowed femur-flutes across the Twin Passes that shriek whenever gusts blow north, panicking pack-mules and masking ambush horns. Zahra believes the bone-carvings preserve pre-dynastic wind-wards worth studying. Clear the Sand-Clan Skirmishers guarding the ridge ledges and bring down the bone-chimes.

Choice A (flag_jawbone_chimes_zahra: Give the intact bone-flutes to npc-zahra-scholar): Zahra decodes the wind-cadence, granting your party +10% movement speed across Redmarsh missions (m14–m23). Choice B (flag_jawbone_chimes_smashed: Smash the cursed flutes on the rocks to quiet the pass immediately): Mules travel calmer (+120 gold caravan bonus), but Zahra calls it an act of vandalism.

Three iron-hooped casks of distilled sweet-water fell off a panicked pack-lizard in Bracken Basin during the dust storm. Cask-Master Tull can smell clean water a league away—and so can the Dune Lurkers burrowing beneath the thorn-scrub. Recover the three brass-spigoted barrels before their staves split in the sun.

After the firepot assault on Highgate Watch, the garrison is out of sour-wine vinegar to cool blistered shields and scrub pitch off timber. Bram hired a one-eyed drover to haul four carboys from the old border cellar, but the cart is stuck near a nest of Claw Vipers. Escort the vinegar cart safely to the outpost gate.

The ruptured plateau wardstones shed finger-length slivers of charged quartz that hold lightning better than copper wire. Widow Marta wants six uncracked splinters to brew static-salve for the vanguard's boots, though Ash-Wraiths drawn to the residual hum prowl the scree. Slay the wraiths haunting the plateau rim.

Since the slave-revolt in the Deep Quarry, two lower galleries groan under unsupported basalt ceilings where thirty rescued miners left their tools and dead kin. Miner Tomas needs heavy cedar pit-props wedged beneath the main fault arch before the roof caves in. Defend the timber-crews while they brace the gallery.

Choice A (flag_quarry_gallery_braced: Hold the gallery until the miners recover their dead and iron tools): Tomas gifts you +15% physical damage for pioneer/melee units in m23-fork-of-spears. Choice B (flag_quarry_gallery_collapsed: Collapse the tunnel early to bury pursuing Pale Burrowers): You finish with zero casualties and +150 gold in salvaged ore, but Tomas mourns the unburied dead.

Raider outriders chipped the distance glyphs off Crossroads Redoubt's milestone and planted false trail-cairns leading supply trains into alkali sinkholes. Warden Hale needs a mounted picket to ride the four approaches and topple the decoy cairns before the baggage column marches at dawn. Destroy the four decoy rock-cairns along the desert tracks.

Kors's shipwrights have green pine planks aplenty, but zero tarred hemp oakum to seal the seams of the troop barges. Three wrecked merchant cogs grounded on the Greywash mudflats still hold dry bales of hemp cordage in their forecastles, guarded by Mire Crocs. Collect four bales of dry hemp oakum from the mudflat wrecks.

Where the Cinder Wards boiled the cliffside groundwater, the heat fused beach sand into thin sheets of sterile volcanic glass—ideal for lancing boils and suturing deep shrapnel wounds without rust fever. Chief Healer Sera needs four unshattered panes from the cooling vents, now prowled by Cinder-Hounds. Slay the hounds nesting among the fumaroles.

When Sundered Ranks fell, a signal-corporal bolted down the sea-cliffs with the iron-bound cipher tables used by coastal watchtowers. If those tables reach Admiral Kael's fleet, every lighthouse beacon between Oakhaven and the straits becomes an enemy guidepost. Track the deserter's trail and eliminate the Coastal Privateers escorting him.

Choice A (flag_semaphore_burned: Burn the cipher tables on the cliff as npc-lyra-warden ordered): Enemy naval bombardment accuracy drops by 20% in m35-burning-harbor. Choice B (flag_semaphore_kept: Keep the cipher tables to decode enemy supply signals): You gain +220 gold from intercepted smugglers, but Korvus's pier batteries target your flank more accurately in m35-burning-harbor.

Even with the Sunken Citadel's sea-gates wedged shut, submerged harbor-chains stretched across the outer channel threaten to rip the keels off Oakhaven's troop transports at low water. The harbor pilot needs sappers protected on the barnacle-slick reef while they file through three anchor-shackles. Reach the three submerged chain-winches before the tide floods back.

With the Twin Riverlocks jammed, Oakhaven's tidal grain-mill can finally grind hardtack for the fleet—except the main wooden axle is bone-dry and smoking like a tinderbox. Mudlark Pip spotted two casks of rendered whale-tallow left behind in a smugglers' cove guarded by Bog Lurkers. Escort Pip's handcart back from the cove without spilling the casks.

Near the fallen Elder Juggernaut on the pine ridge, magnetic ore veins spin iron compass needles in circles—a fatal hazard once the fleet enters the volcanic fog of the southern straits. The harbor pilot needs four fist-sized chunks of natural lodestone to re-magnetize the ships' binnacles. Collect four magnetic lodestone nodules from the shattered ridge.

Baron Vane's tax-bailiffs locked forty barrels of salted herring and twelve crates of crossbow strings inside his flooded sea-cellar before fleeing the keep. Tide-Ghouls drawn to the brine have nested behind the iron grate. Clear the ghouls out of the lower vault so Oakhaven's dockworkers can haul out the provisions.

Choice A (flag_baron_cellar_town: Distribute the salted herring to Oakhaven's dockworkers): Dockworkers volunteer to crew the fire-brigades in m35-burning-harbor (+15% pier durability). Choice B (flag_baron_cellar_sold: Sell the preserved rations to privateer captains in the bay): You pocket +300 gold immediately, but Oakhaven's dockworkers jeer your vanguard.

Two supply teams already lost mules to boiling sulfur sinkholes between the landing coves and Highcrest bluff. Ash-Scouts have forged iron warning-stakes tipped with white chalk, but Ash-Stalkers keep ambushing anyone who strays off the basalt ridge. Reach the four thin-crust fissures and drive in the warning-stakes.

Shattering the Obsidian Beacons left behind heaps of vitrified prism-sand that turns ordinary quenched steel blue-hard when sprinkled into the crucible. Vok needs five pouches of ground prism-sand before his apprentices can re-edge the vanguard's halberds, though Spark Elementals still crackle around the ruins. Collect five pouches of prism-sand from the beacon crags.

Greystone Bastion's east wall survived the demonic catapults, but its mortar joints are cracked from parapet to footing. Siege sappers are mixing pulverized volcanic pumice with hot brine to seal the fractures before ash-squalls erode the stone. Defend the mason-sappers on the outer ledge from prowling Slag Fiends.

Choice A (flag_greystone_mortar_cured: Hold the ledge until the pumice mortar cures completely): Greystone's garrison reinforces your rear guard, granting +10% armor to infantry in m41-gauntlet-of-iron. Choice B (flag_greystone_mortar_rushed: Pull the sappers back early to salvage their bronze mixing-cauldrons): You gain +280 gold in salvaged bronze, but Greystone's east wall remains fragile.

When Arch-Mage Malrik fell in Ashveil Gorge, three of his bound Shadow Constructs remained anchored to obsidian monoliths in the side clefts, attacking every dispatch rider carrying wounded back to Ironcamp. Brother Elias knows the counter-sigils to unbind them cleanly. Destroy the three Shadow Constructs haunting the gorge.

The raw iron cliffs of the Gauntlet tug heavy plate armor sideways and deflect crossbow bolts mid-flight. Captain Rowan's sappers forged copper-sheathed grounding spikes to bleed off the canyon's magnetic pull before the supply train marches through. Escort the sapper-cart through the cleared checkpoint gates while they hammer in the spikes.

Choice A (flag_gauntlet_grounded: Ground the entire canyon wall cleanly): Ranged accuracy across Act 4 missions (m42–m46) increases by +15%. Choice B (flag_gauntlet_overloaded: Overload the spikes to shatter the cliffside iron veins for Vok's forge): You gain +350 gold in raw magnetic ore, but falling rock injures two sappers.

Scattered along the obsidian stair below the Threshold Chamber lie the charred brass name-plates of the original First Watch wardens who died sealing the caldera centuries ago. Elias wishes to recover five intact name-plates so their oaths are formally witnessed before the final door opens. Collect five charred brass warden-plates from the obsidian stair.
Gnoll raiders dragged the heavy iron ferry-chain into the shallows below the Old Border Mint, halving river crossings. Haul the chain links back before high water.

list: Clear the Briar Hounds scavenging near loc-border-mint-ruin
Recover 3 Heavy Toll-Chain Links from the river mud
Return the chain links to Clerk Oswin

p: Bog-gas flares drove Mara's cutters from the southern hollow, leaving five iron-shod spades behind. Extinguish the Mire Wisps and retrieve the tools.

list: Disperse 6 Mire Wisps in loc-willow-sink
Collect 5 Iron-Shod Peat Spades

p: Ruin Mites are chewing through the old levy-rolls stored in Ravenwatch's guard-cellar. Exterminate the nest and save the surviving muster ledgers.

list: Slay 10 Ruin Mites inside loc-ravenwatch-cellar
Recover 4 Vellum Muster-Rolls
Deliver the rolls to Captain Garrick

p: The limestone beacon along Lantern Passage burned dry after Cinder Shamans fouled its oil-cistern. Carry fresh tallow-casks up the switchback and relight the cage.

list: Eliminate the Cinder Shaman near loc-hermit-lamp-post
Refill and ignite the Third Lantern Post

p: Thorn Boars rooted up the timber yard outside Greywood Water-Mill, scattering Dobb's tempered crosscut blades. Drive off the beasts and gather the steel.

list: Kill 5 Thorn Boars around loc-greywood-sawmill
Retrieve 3 Tempered Crosscut Blades

p: Early sleet blinded the watershed ridge above Ravenwatch, leaving scouts stranded in the pass. Haul pine-pitch barrels to relight the twin weather-cairns.

list: Reach loc-craghorn-saddle
Slay 4 Glasswings circling the ridge
Ignite both Craghorn Weather-Cairns

p: Quill Fiends nested in the white-clay gullies above Alder Bridge, sniping baggage mules from cover. Clear the ridge and plant sharpened ash stakes.

list: Slay 8 Quill Fiends at loc-alder-bluff
Place 4 Sharpened Ash Stakes along the embankment

p: Widow Marta needs chunks of vitrified green silica from the old quarry kilns to grind into eye-salve powder, though Flintbacks sleep among the cold furnaces.

list: Gather 6 Green Silica Slag Chunks from loc-vitrified-kilns
Defeat 3 Flintbacks guarding the slag heaps
Bring the slag chunks to Widow Marta

p: After the Ashbrook skirmish, dozens of fallen militiamen were buried hastily in the south ditch with their stamped brass pay-disks. Recover the disks before Gloom Stags desecrate the cairns.

list: Drive off 3 Gloom Stags prowling loc-ashbrook-turnip-field
Collect 7 Stamped Brass Pay-Disks

title: Bent Pikes of the Sunken Ford

p: Rootbound hulks snapped half the garrison's boar-spears during the last ford patrol. Recover the broken steel heads from the creek bed so Hobb can re-weld them.

list: Destroy 2 Rootbound lurking near loc-thornwick-weir
Salvage 6 Snapped Pike-Heads

p: Dry desert winds split the rawhide lashings binding Redmarsh's leviathan-bone gate. Harvest tough Dune Beast hides to re-lash the timbers before the next dust squall.

list: Slay 4 Dune Beasts near loc-whale-rib-gate
Deliver 4 Thick Dune-Beast Hides to Warden Hale

p: Sand-clan spotters etched caravan schedules and tribal clan-marks into the sandstone lintel of the East Jawbone Blind. Make charcoal rubbings before wind scours the stone.

list: Clear the Sand Raiders holding loc-jawbone-east-blind
Take 3 Charcoal Lintel Rubbings
Return the rubbings to Zahra

p: Raider scouts use polished bronze mirrors hidden in the Bracken Hoodoo Maze to flash ambush signals across the basin. Smash the mirror stands.

list: Navigate loc-bracken-hoodoos and destroy 4 Bronze Heliograph Stands
Eliminate 6 Dune Lurkers nesting in the maze

p: Unexploded clay firepots from the Highgate assault still lie half-buried in the dry arroyo. Recover the intact jars before Storm Kites spark the brush.

list: Slay 5 Storm Kites above loc-highgate-creek
Recover 5 Intact Clay Firepots

p: Dune Scarabs drawn to the Third Quartz Monolith have grown charged copper horns capable of grounding wild static. Harvest their forked horns for Surveyor Nira.

list: Kill 8 Dune Scarabs around loc-third-wardstone
Collect 6 Forked Copper Beetle-Horns

p: Maggot Swarms fouled the Bitter Milestone Well along the corduroy road, tainting the sole watering trough for ten leagues. Purge the larvae and drop quicklime bags.

list: Burn 4 Maggot Swarms around loc-third-milestone-well
Lower 3 Quicklime Purifying Sacks into the well

p: Cask-Master Tull needs the precision brass balance-beams locked inside Redrock Canyon Vault to weigh salt-tax silver fairly, though Scale Vipers coil in the cool sandstone.

list: Slay 6 Scale Vipers inside loc-redrock-assay-vault
Recover the Brass Assay Balance-Set

p: Witch Doctors at the Twelve Megaliths boil marsh bitumen with willow-ash to coat hex-stones. Scrape three jars of the thick residue for Widow Marta's counter-salves.

list: Defeat 3 Witch Doctors at loc-megalith-hollow

summary: A jagged reef impaling the broken hulls of three royal patrol galleys.

p: A jagged reef impaling the broken hulls of three royal patrol galleys.
Barnacle-covered oars wash back and forth in the red-stained surf.

title: Harbor Chain-Winch
summary: A squat capstan house holding one end of a rusted harbor-blocking iron chain.

p: A squat capstan house holding one end of a rusted harbor-blocking iron chain.
Thick links trail straight down into the crashing waves like a sea-serpent.

title: Tide-Hollow Grotto
summary: A basalt cavern accessible only at low water, stacked with tarred brandy casks.

p: A basalt cavern accessible only at low water, stacked with tarred brandy casks.
Wet bootprints lead deeper into the dark behind a false wall of driftwood.

title: Mariner's Cliff-Niche
summary: Shallow caves cut into the sea-cliff where drowned sailors' skulls rest behind iron grilles.

p: Shallow caves cut into the sea-cliff where drowned sailors' skulls rest behind iron grilles.
Salt-crusted copper coins glint inside empty eye sockets.

title: Sea-Cliff Anchor Smithy
summary: An open-air stone hearth battered by spray, flanked by half-forged iron flukes.

p: An open-air stone hearth battered by spray, flanked by half-forged iron flukes.
A massive cracked anvil sits tilted in the wet shingle.

title: The Abyssal Tide-Pool
summary: A deep circular sinkhole in the coastal rock that churns violently even in calm weather.

p: A deep circular sinkhole in the coastal rock that churns violently even in calm weather.
Carved stone steps descend straight into the black, foaming water.

title: False-Harbor Gallows
summary: A tall timber crane perched on a jagged headland to lure merchant ships onto the rocks.

p: A tall timber crane perched on a jagged headland to lure merchant ships onto the rocks.
Shattered cargo crates and bleached ribs litter the coves directly below.

title: The Ash-Choked Viaduct
summary: A towering stone aqueduct whose dry channel is packed three feet deep with gray soot.

p: A towering stone aqueduct whose dry channel is packed three feet deep with gray soot.
Scorched royal banners hang limp from the arches over the barren plain.

title: The Blackened Groves
summary: Rows of petrified apple trees turned to charcoal by rolling ember-winds from the capital.

p: Rows of petrified apple trees turned to charcoal by rolling ember-winds from the capital.
Brittle branches snap like dry bones underfoot in the dead silence.

title: Royal Gunpowder Foundry
summary: A blackened stone manufactory ringed by slag heaps and shattered bronze cannon molds.

p: A blackened stone manufactory ringed by slag heaps and shattered bronze cannon molds.
Sulfur dust coats the floor beside half-filled barrels of coarse black powder.

title: The Iron-Cage Crossroads
summary: Tall iron gibbets creaking in the hot wind along the main highway to the inner walls.

p: Tall iron gibbets creaking in the hot wind along the main highway to the inner walls.
Charred parchment decrees remain nailed to the stone base of each post.

title: Square of the Molten Bell
summary: A cracked marble plaza dominated by a massive cathedral bell fused into a lump of bronze.

p: A cracked marble plaza dominated by a massive cathedral bell fused into a lump of bronze.
Vitrified cobbles mark where crown-fire rained down during the purge.

title: The Soot-Sealed Cistern
summary: A domed brick reservoir whose iron hatch was welded shut to keep ash from fouling the water.

p: A domed brick reservoir whose iron hatch was welded shut to keep ash from fouling the water.
Scratch marks cover the bronze door where desperate hands tried to pry it open.

title: Scorched Watch-Bastion
summary: A soot-stained fortress gatehouse flanked by cold iron braziers ten feet wide.

p: A soot-stained fortress gatehouse flanked by cold iron braziers ten feet wide.
Rows of blackened halberds stand neatly racked beside piles of fused armor.

title: The Cindered Chancellery
summary: Gutted marble halls where thousands of tax rolls and noble pedigrees burned to black flakes.

p: Gutted marble halls where thousands of tax rolls and noble pedigrees burned to black flakes.
A single iron strongbox sits untouched amid knee-deep drifts of paper ash.

title: Ember-Glass Quarry
summary: Jagged pits of black volcanic glass mined to tip the spears of the royal vanguard.

p: Jagged pits of black volcanic glass mined to tip the spears of the royal vanguard.
Razor-sharp splinters glint across the churned earth like fallen stars.

title: The Cinder Causeway
summary: A wide basalt road lined with headless statues leading directly toward the smoking citadel.

p: A wide basalt road lined with headless statues leading directly toward the smoking citadel.
Hot cinders drift across the paving stones like dying fireflies.
A gaunt border militiaman in a dented kettle-helm with soot smeared across both cheeks.
Carries: A notched halberd and a cracked horn lantern.

list: Keep low by the gatehouse—their archers have the cobbled lane ranged to the inch.
Gate timbers are holding, barely. Tell Garrick we need iron wedges.

p: A shivering middle-aged scribe clutching a wet wool cloak over ink-stained fingers.
Carries: A brass-bound tally slate and a broken padlock.

list: Three months of river tariffs sank in that ditch! Don't let the gnolls chew the box.
If the silver's gone, Thornwick's militia won't stay past sundown.

p: A wiry woman wrapped in greased horsehide with mud dried up to her thighs.
Carries: A long iron-shod peat spade.

list: Step only on the black tussocks—green moss hides sinkholes deep enough to swallow a horse.
Keep your torches hooded; bog-lights draw things with teeth.

p: A breathless young outrider with a blood-soaked bandage wrapped around her left calf.
Carries: An empty leather dispatch tube.

list: The bone totems in the pines are feeding their wards—burn them before night falls!
My leg won't carry me back up the ridge, so make every arrow count.

p: A broad-shouldered woodcutter missing two fingers, wearing a sawdust-caked leather apron.
Carries: A two-man crosscut saw slung over one shoulder.

list: Tarn's turncoats locked our best iron axes inside the central timber shed.
Burn their pork barrels, just leave the seasoned oak planks intact.

p: A sun-darkened ranger in salt-stiffened rawhide with a cracked spyglass hung at his neck.
Carries: A curved horn-bow and a bundle of signal flags.

list: Dust storms roll off the basin without warning—keep horns close or lose half your column.
The ridge blinds are clear for now, though raiders still prowl the dry arroyos.

p: A stocky quarryman covered in black ironstone dust with raw chain-chafes around his wrists.
Carries: A heavy steel quarry-pick.

list: Break the slave-pen locks on the middle terrace and three hundred picks join your line!
Gorrathul's overseers hid the hoist keys in the pit—bury them.

p: A one-eyed caravan driver with cracked lips and a salt-crusted felt hat.
Carries: A braided rawhide mule-whip.

list: My lead mules bolted when the sand-raiders whistled—help me haul these crates off the flats!
Never trust a dry creek bed at noon; lurkers sleep two inches under the crust.

p: An indigo-robed scholar squinting through smoked-quartz spectacles against blowing grit.
Carries: A brass plumb-bob and charcoal rubbing-pad.

list: The quartz spire is cracking! Kill the blood-chanters before the static cooks us alive!
Keep those rubbings dry—Zahra will need every glyph on that parchment.

p: A hollow-cheeked pikeman leaning heavily on a spear beside a chained iron well-cover.
Carries: A battered copper ladle.

list: One drop of beetle-bile ruins a whole cistern—keep those scourges off the stone rim!
Water's rationed to half a pint till Bram's wagons reach the gate.

p: A salt-cured infantry corporal in a rusted breastplate with seaweed tangled in his greaves.
Carries: A notched boarding-axe.

list: Watch the tide-lines—heavy mail sinks like an anchor when the surf rolls over the spit!
Hold the plank-walk; Oakhaven's marines are right behind you.

p: A weather-beaten coast pilot in oiled yellow canvas with brass dividers tucked in his sash.
Carries: A salt-stained sounding lead and line.

list: You have two hours before spring tide floods the lower ward—move fast or drown in plate!
Keep off the kelp-slick steps; one slip drops you straight into the sluice.

p: A pale apprentice surgeon in a vinegar-soaked apron with blood dried under her fingernails.
Carries: A wicker tray of boiled linen rolls.

list: Keep those cleaver-happy raiders off the tent ropes—half our wounded can't even crawl!
Sera's loading the last stretchers now; hold the creek trail ten more minutes.

p: A grease-stained canal mechanic with a swollen bruised shoulder and a heavy iron wrench.
Carries: A three-foot iron gear-wedge.

list: Drive these wedges into the center capstan before their sappers trip the floodgates!
Those gears won't turn again this winter—the east bridge is safe.

p: A soot-blackened dockworker coughing through a wet wool scarf tied over his nose.
Carries: A hooked fire-pike and sand bucket.

list: Pitch-pots are raining off Kael's flagship—clear the seawall stairs so we can douse the piers!
Save the drydocks first; without hulls, we never cross the southern straits.

p: A lean vanguard scout in soot-grey leather with smoked-glass goggles pushed onto his forehead.
Carries: A bundle of white-chalked warning stakes.

list: Stay off the yellow crust—boiling sulfur sits two inches beneath that brittle shell!
Highcrest bluff is clear, though the ash-storms are thickening to the east.

p: A squat, burn-scarred engineer wearing thick leather welding gauntlets and an iron visor.
Carries: A keg of black prism-powder.

list: Cover my team while we set the charges on the West Conduit—one spark ends us early!
Charges are primed; clear the dais before the stone splits.

p: A exhausted Greystone defender in cracked basalt-dusted plate with a sling on his left arm.
Carries: A heavy steel windlass crossbow.

list: Three demonic catapults are chewing our east parapet to gravel—sally out and burn them!
Parapet's patched with pumice mortar, though my ears are still ringing.

p: A barefoot ash-robed witness carrying a chain of tarnished brass name-plates.
Carries: A small iron censer smoking with grey ash.

list: Speak softly in the nave—the First Watch still stands bound to those obsidian pillars.
Two doors, two prices. Choose which temperature you want for Thornvael.

p: A shirtless, keloid-scarred forge-hand wearing a heavy asbestos-lined leather apron.
Carries: Long iron crucible tongs.

list: Vok needs slag-billets from the lower vents before we can re-temper your vanguard's shields!
Keep your steel oiled; volcanic fumes pit bare iron in half an hour.

p: A stooped river-man in a tarred leather jerkin with rope-calloused hands and milky eyes.
Carries: A ten-foot ashwood punt-pole and a rusted tin bailer.

list: Bridge is out upstream, and the toll-brigands watch the shallow gravel. Pay a silver if you want dry knees.
Current's running strong today; keep your armor strapped tight in the skiff.

p: A wiry trader bent beneath a towering wicker pack clanking with pots, tallow, and dried herbs.
Carries: A gnarled walking staff notched with mile-marks.

list: Even the highwaymen rarely rob a man carrying turnips and boot-grease—too heavy to run with!
Need spare bowstrings or oilskin? Better buy before you reach the fens.

p: A hollow-cheeked pikeman missing one boot, wearing a muddy cloak with torn royal insignia.
Carries: A snapped pike-shaft used as a crutch.

list: They sent twenty of us to hold a flooded ditch without rations. I chose mud over a grave.
If you see Thornwick patrols, tell them Vane drowned at the ford.

p: An elderly woman in a homespun shawl stained green at the cuffs from crushed river-mint.
Carries: A woven rush basket brimming with muddy roots.

list: Chew white willow bark when the river-chill gets in your joints—keeps the shaking fever off.
The reeds grow thicker every year where blood was spilled.

p: A barefoot penitent wrapped in coarse burlap, his forehead smudged with gray river-ash.
Carries: A carved wooden rosary and a battered tin alms-bowl.

list: I walk the old border stones to pray for those who fell before the Compact broke.
No shrine stands untouched by greed, yet the stones still remember.

p: A soot-speckled youth wearing spectacles mended with copper wire and a scorched leather apron.
Carries: A portable charcoal brazier and a ring of iron tongs.

list: Cracked kettle? Bent buckle? Give me ten minutes and a pinch of flux, good as forged!
I stay close to the crossroads—soldiers always break something.

p: A broad-shouldered bogman caked to the waist in black mud, squinting through a cloud of midges.
Carries: A long-handled iron turf-spade.

list: Dug up three rusted helmets and a pickled hand before noon. Redmarsh never lets go of anything.
Keep to the white-marked stakes unless you fancy sinking to your chin.

p: A skeletal recluse draped in woven sedge-mats, his beard tangled with dried duckweed.
Carries: A crooked driftwood crook hung with dried frog-skins.

list: Civilization rots faster than bog-oak. Out here, at least the monsters don't levy taxes.
The mire-heretics chant at midnight; plug your ears with beeswax.

p: A gaunt physician in a waxed oilcloth coat and a wide-brimmed hat stuffed with dried wormwood.
Carries: A wooden crate clinking with stoppered glass leech-jars.

list: Swamp-bloat kills more mercenaries than steel! My leeches draw the black humor right out.
Never scratch a bog-fly bite; rub it with bitter-root paste.

p: A mud-splattered scholar clutching a waterproof leather scroll-case against his chest.
Carries: A brass sighting-level and a knotted measuring cord.

list: Half the roads on the royal map sank three winters ago! I'm redrawing the dikes before another column drowns.
If you spot solid stone ruins, mark them for me—everything else is shifting peat.

p: A wiry woman in patched waders with a necklace of tarnished buckles and salvaged buttons.
Carries: A long wooden pole fitted with a three-pronged iron grapple.

list: You fight the ghouls, I fish their pockets out of the silt—fair division of labor, wouldn't you say?
Nothing's truly lost in Redmarsh if your grappling hook is long enough.

p: A wild-eyed fanatic wearing a spiked iron collar over scarred, mud-streaked shoulders.
Carries: A knotted hemp scourge stained dark.

list: The Mire is our purgatory! Only through cold mud and bitter pain are our sins washed clean!
Do not strike the heretics with anger—pity their blindness!

p: A barrel-chested coastal woman with salt-bleached hair and scars from barnacle cuts across both forearms.
Carries: A greased seal-bladder float and a heavy iron pry-bar.

list: Three royal pay-ships went down off these reefs last gale. Corsairs get the decks; I get the holds.
Watch the tide-pools—reef-stalkers nest under the rusted hulls.

p: A sun-baked laborer with cracked lips, squinted eyes, and boots crusted white with dried brine.
Carries: A wide wooden salt-scraper.

list: Royal taxmen take nine bushels of salt out of ten, and leave us to fend off pirates with wooden rakes.
Fresh water's worth twice as much as grog along this stretch of cliff.

p: A muscular man bearing raw iron-shackle scars on both wrists and a stolen corsair sash.
Carries: A broken galley-oar bound with iron bands.

list: Rowed for Draven's raiders four years before a reef cracked our keel. Never wearing chains again.
If you spot a slaver patrol, hit the whip-master first—the rest scatter.

p: A wind-worn ranger wrapped in gull-gray wool with a thick leather gauntlet reaching her elbow.
Carries: A hooded sea-hawk perched on a driftwood T-bar.

list: My bird spots corsair sails three leagues out. Right now, two longboats are hugging the southern cove.
Cliff-harpies hate falcons—keeps them off my perch, at least.

p: A hunchbacked sailor sitting on an upturned tar barrel, fingers flying through knotted hemp twine.
Carries: A bone netting-needle and a coil of tarred cord.

list: Used to haul silver cod by the ton. Now half the time we pull up drowned bones or barnacle-crabs.
Never cast a net near the Abyssal Pool unless you want something pulling back.

p: A pale, gaunt old man smelling strongly of whale-oil and damp wool, squinting against the daylight.
Carries: A brass oil-can and a heavy ring of iron tower keys.

list: Without whale-oil for the beacon, ships pile onto the teeth every night—and wreckers cheer.
The sea takes everything we build; we just pile stones back up.

p: A coughing worker wrapped in gray rags with a wet cloth tied tightly over his nose and mouth.
Carries: A wide iron coal-shovel and a creaking wooden handcart.

list: They pay two coppers a barrow to clear cinders off the royal road. Still cheaper than hiring soldiers.
Don't kick the gray drifts—hot embers hide underneath for days.

p: A trembling former court clerk in singed velvet robes, clutching half-burned tax rolls to his chest.
Carries: A cracked inkhorn and a bundle of charred vellum.

list: When the Inquisitor ordered the archives burned, I ran with the real debt-ledgers. Now I'm a dead man walking.
Every noble in the capital owes blood-gold to the Cinder Throne.

p: A scarred heavy infantryman in blackened plate with the royal crest hammered flat off his breastplate.
Carries: A notched tower shield and a dented water-canteen.

list: I served the Crown twenty years until they ordered us to torch our own granaries. Let the Sovereign choke on his ashes.
Pyre-knights fight blind inside those heavy helms—strike their knees.

p: A soot-stained medic wearing scorched linen bandages around her forearms and a pouch of grease-pots.
Carries: A wooden mortar and a tin flask of goose-fat salve.

list: Crown-fire blisters through boiled leather in seconds. Rub mutton-tallow on your skin before you face them.
Water's scarcer than silver out here; don't waste a drop washing your face.

p: A lean rogue in a reversible charcoal cloak with soot smeared deliberately across his brow.
Carries: A lead-lined lockbox slung over one shoulder.

list: Rich lords pay fortunes to sneak family heirlooms out of the capital before the whole city turns to slag.
Inquisitors search wagons, never ash-carts.

p: A wild-haired old man in scorched rags pointing a blackened finger toward the smoking citadel.
Carries: A cracked bronze hand-bell without a clapper.

list: Gold melts, iron bends, flesh chars—only the ash remains equal under the Sovereign's sky!
Listen to the wind through the viaducts; it sings the requiem of kings!
